apps.name: Bulk AI
apps.subtitle: Dynamic, adherence-neutral nutrition tracker
apps.localizedDescription: Bulk AI tracks your weight trend with EWMA smoothing, computes your TDEE dynamically from real intake plus weight change, and proposes new daily targets every week via an adherence-neutral check-in. Forked from Fud AI (MIT). iOS only.
